'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]] captures the [[Vuhlehirska Power Station]], [[Ukraine]]'s second largest power plant, near the city of [[Svitlodarsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-captures-power-station-redeploys-troops-toward-southern-ukraine-2022-07-27/ (Reuters)]
***Russia says that it has destroyed more than 100 [[M142 HIMARS]] missiles in an [[airstrike]] on [[Dnipro]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-its-strike-july-24-destroyed-100-himars-missiles-2022-07-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[Anti-MONUSCO protests]]
***Four protesters are killed when a soldier shoots an electric cable that falls on them in [[Uvira]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. They were protesting the ineffectiveness of the [[MONUSCO]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/four-dead-anti-un-protests-spread-congo-2022-07-27/ (Reuters)]
**The [[Burundi Human Rights Initiative]] (BHRI) accuses [[Burundi]] of sending troops into the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to fight the RED-Tabara, a Burundian armed opposition group. The BHRI also accuses Burundi of supporting armed groups that oppose the DRC. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/27/rights-group-concerned-about-burundis-secret-mission-in-drc (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009-present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Eleven people, including a [[Federal Government of Somalia|government]] official, are killed by an [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[suicide bombing]] at the entrance to a government building in [[Merca]], [[Lower Shabelle]], [[Somalia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-bombings-somalia-suicide-mogadishu-2d51274f2bdd3b3220c8f91d7ce00607 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**The [[Federal Reserve]] consecutively increases its benchmark interest rate by 0.75%. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/07/27/fed-decision-july-2022-.html (CNBC)]
*[[Russia in the European energy sector]]
**[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]]
***Russian energy company [[Gazprom]] reduces the amount of [[natural gas]] flowing through the [[Nord Stream|Nord Stream 1]] pipeline from Russia to Europe to 20% of the pipeline's capacity. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-germany-d040fce8b07abc2ab6bb2cbf31a0df47 (AP)]
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[McDonald's]] profits fall by 46% and its revenue falls by 3% in Q2 2022 following the company's exit from Russia. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/mcdonalds-reports-lower-q2-sales-charges-weigh-down-profit/2022/07/26/f24d91d6-0cd9-11ed-88e8-c58dc3dbaee2_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Luzon earthquake]]
**A magnitude 7.1 [[list of earthquakes in the Philippines|earthquake]] hits [[Luzon]], [[Philippines]], killing four people and injuring over 100 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/magnitude-72-earthquake-strikes-luzon-philippines-emsc-2022-07-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 California wildfires]]
**Evacuation orders are lifted in [[Mariposa County, California|Mariposa County]] and highways reopen as the [[Oak Fire (2022)|Oak Fire]] slows and becomes the largest this season. [https://www.mercurynews.com/2022/07/27/map-oak-fire-evacuations-and-perimeter-near-yosemite/ (''The Mercury News'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***The [[U.S.]] reports 1,049 new cases of monkeypox, thereby bringing the total number of cases in the country to 4,639. [https://www.cdc.gov/poxvirus/monkeypox/response/2022/us-map.html (CDC)]
***The [[federal government of the United States|U.S. government]] orders the release of 800,000 doses of [[Bavarian Nordic]]'s [[Smallpox_vaccine#Jynneos|Jynneos]] vaccine from the [[Strategic National Stockpile]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/medical/us-signs-off-on-800000-more-doses-of-monkeypox-vaccine/ar-AA102e3d (AP)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Samoa]]
***Prime Minister [[Fiamē Naomi Mataʻafa]] ends [[Samoa]]'s [[state of emergency]] after two years. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/471668/samoa-to-end-covid-state-of-emergency-ahead-of-reopening (RNZ)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The Joint Coordination Center opens in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]], to coordinate the export of millions of tonnes of grain from blockaded [[Black Sea]] ports. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2022/7/26/russia-ukraine-live-blog-kyiv-accuses-moscow-of-price-terror (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**The United States offers to [[Prisoner exchange|exchange]] imprisoned Russian arms dealer [[Viktor Bout]] for detained Americans [[Brittney Griner]] and [[Paul Whelan (security director)|Paul Whelan]], who are accused of drug offenses and spying, respectively. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/07/27/politics/griner-whelan-biden-offer-viktor-bout-exchange-russia-arms-dealer/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Media freedom in the European Union]]
**The [[General Court (European Union)|European General Court]] upholds a broadcast ban imposed on [[Russia]]n television network [[RT (TV network)|RT]] in the [[European Union]] over accusations of spreading misinformation, rejecting an appeal against the ban. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/27/european-court-upholds-broadcasting-ban-on-russias-rt (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/eu-court-backs-eu-ban-russia-today-2022-07-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Highland Park parade shooting]]
**The suspect in the [[mass shooting]] at an [[Independence Day (United States)|Independence Day]] parade in [[Highland Park, Illinois]], U.S., is formally indicted on 21 counts of [[first-degree murder]], 48 counts of [[attempted murder]], and 48 counts of [[aggravated battery]]. There are three counts per slain victim and two counts per injured victim. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/highland-park-parade-mass-shooting-suspect-indicted-117-charges-illino-rcna40332 (NBC News)]
*[[2016 South Korean political scandal]]
**[[Prime Minister of South Korea]] [[Han Duck-soo]] says that he will ask [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk-yeol]] to pardon former [[Samsung]] executive [[Lee Jae-yong (businessman)|Lee Jae-yong]], who is currently on parole for [[bribery]] and [[embezzlement]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/skorea-pm-says-he-will-recommend-special-pardon-samsungs-lee-president-yonhap-2022-07-27/ (Reuters)] [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20220727008300315?section=news (Yonhap)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Tunisian constitutional referendum]]
**A majority of [[Tunisia]]n voters approve a new [[Constitution of Tunisia|constitution]], proposed by [[President of Tunisia|President]] [[Kais Saied]] as a solution to the country's ongoing [[2021–2022 Tunisian political crisis|political crisis]]. However, voter turnout was only 30.5%, due to a boycott of the referendum by opposition parties. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-tunisia-constitutions-tunis-government-and-politics-c0781f4838129af410a72701ff44ef4d (AP)]
*[[2021–2022 Iraqi political crisis]]
**Hundreds of protestors storm the parliament building in the [[Green Zone]] in [[Baghdad]] to oppose the nomination of [[Mohammed Shia' Al Sudani]] for prime minister by pro-[[Iran|Iranian]] parties. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/27/iraqi-protesters-storm-parliament-muqtada-al-sadr-green-zone (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[List of diamonds|Lulo Rose]], a [[pink diamond]], the largest in 300 years, is discovered at the Lulo [[mining in Angola|mine]] in [[Lunda Norte Province]], [[Angola]]. [https://apnews.com/article/angola-large-caret-pink-diamond-discovered-2425e083d430f253609f077801d5c1d5 (AP)]
*The [[Google Street View]] service is launched in [[India]] 11 years after the service was banned in the country over security concerns. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/google-maps-launches-street-view-service-india-2022-07-27/ (Reuters)]
